newsitem.title: UK: Fritz opens new branch in Aberdeen.
newsitem.headline: Fritz opens new branch in Aberdeen.

text.p: Fritz Companies (UK) Ltd, said it has opened a new 1500 sq ft branch in Aberdeen, Scotland, bringing the total of Fritz UK locations to 18.

The new branch will initially handle inbound oil-related traffic from the Fritz worldwide network and will target oil-related exporters in its local area. At a later date it will look for business from other industries such as textiles and food prodution, the company said in a statement.
The manager of the new operation is Crawford Hendy, who will report to regional manager Jim Tierney.

Because of anticipated growth Fritz has only taken a 12-month lease on the site. Tierney said:"Aberdeen is a unique market, and we expect to double our business inside a year and to open a major logistics centre within four years." - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
